metadata.title: Spy Party — Who Is the Spy
metadata.description: Get a secret word, describe it cleverly, and unmask the impostor. A social deduction game for your group — play online or offline.

hero.tagline: Everyone gets a secret word. The spy gets a <hl>similar</hl> one. Describe it cleverly, vote sharply — and unmask the impostor before it's too late.

civilian.title: Civilian
civilian.desc: You and your teammates share one word. Describe it clearly enough to recognize each other — but not so plainly that the spy guesses your word.

spy.title: Spy
spy.desc: You get a similar word but don't know the original. Blend into the crowd, describe it vaguely, and survive each round of voting.

01.title: Create a room
01.desc: Pick the player count, the number of spies, and a topic.

02.title: Get your word
02.desc: Each agent opens their classified dossier to see their own word.

03.title: Describe
03.desc: Taking turns, everyone gives one clue for their word.

04.title: Hunt
04.desc: Vote to eliminate a suspect. Unmask every spy to win.

cta.heading: Ready to play your part?
cta.desc: Gather your team, deal the dossiers, and see who the real impostor is.

notFound.title: Dossier not found
notFound.description: The page you're looking for was moved or never existed.

dossier.hintBefore: Tap to see which word you got
dossier.hintAfter: Two similar words to sow confusion

offline.setupDesc: Add your agents, choose how many spies, and pick a topic. This device deals the words.
offline.topicHint: The dealt words come from this topic.
offline.needPlayers: Add at least {min} agents to start.
offline.tooManySpies: Too many spies for this many agents.
offline.reviewDoneDesc: Now describe your word out loud — one clue each — then vote.
offline.describeDesc: Taking turns in seat order, each agent gives one clue for their own word — out loud, in person.
offline.votePrompt: Agree out loud, then tap the agent to eliminate.
offline.revoteDesc: Choose again — only the tied agents can be picked.
offline.noOneEliminated: No one was eliminated this round.
